title: Jesse feels Strieber's implant

tellings.quote: Yeah, I felt it and it's the weirdest thing in the world. And he says it moves with his own metabolism.
I felt an implant in his ear
tellings.difference: Places the implant in Strieber's ear and does not repeat the claim that it moves with his metabolism.
tellings.link_reason: Jesse Michels describes feeling Whitley Strieber's implant himself, the same personal event as the existing story.

as_told.title: Host feels implant in Whitley Strieber's ear

plain: Michels says he touched an implant in the body of the writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens, and calls it "the weirdest thing in the world." Michels tells it as his own experience and adds that Strieber says the object moves with his own metabolism, as if it were alive in him. In a later episode Michels tells it more briefly and places it in Strieber's ear: "I felt an implant in his ear."
